hypothesis: Replacing the 19-frame local temporal receptive field with a 32-mode global Fourier temporal mixer will let the otherwise identical 64x64x101 Factorized FNO memorize one train/Marmousi P_bg record below relative L2 0.10 within 200 updates.
literature_basis: Factorized Fourier Neural Operators motivate separable global spectral mixing; project diagnostics identify long-horizon low-spatial-mode phase as the dominant error.
expected_mechanism: Every temporal output can depend on all 101 stored input times through rFFT-mode mixing, removing the local temporal bottleneck while retaining the same spatial encoder and output head.

single_conceptual_variable.name: temporal_mixer
single_conceptual_variable.parent: three local depthwise kernel-7 convolution layers

failure_signal: Relative L2 above 0.50 after 200 updates rejects the spectral temporal replacement; non-finite values, OOM, or missing checkpoint also reject.
rollback: Preserve r33 and all prior artifacts; if rejected, replace the factorized architecture rather than tuning on confirmation or project validation/test_id.
